_doc: Callees whose return value is non-null by their own documented contract. Each entry needs a reason; a use of their result counts as non-null. Keep this list short - it is a claim the page rests on.

nonnull.reason: Dear ImGui returns the current window's draw list; asserts a current window, never returns NULL inside a frame
Dear ImGui returns a viewport-owned list, never NULL while a context exists
Dear ImGui: Viewports[0] always exists while a context exists
Dear ImGui: the current font is always set inside a frame
spdlog creates the default logger during static initialisation and AMF only ever replaces it with a constructed logger (never set_default_logger(nullptr)); the logger:: macros go through it
include/utils/NullGuard.h: returns its argument when it is non-null, else the literal "" - never null
include/utils/NullGuard.h (AMF_OR): returns its argument when it is non-null, else the fallback, which is a string literal by type (const char (&)[N]) - never null
Strings.cpp: returns the translation's c_str() or the caller's English text; every call site passes a string literal as the English text

nonnull_fields.reason: Dear ImGui: CreateContext() always creates the font atlas (or takes the shared one passed in); io.Fonts is never NULL while a context exists
